  "title": "Edit log statements where a Pod's IP address is logged.",
  "body": "To lower the risk of logging sensitive information we need to tweak log messages where customer payload's Pod IP address is logged.\r\n\r\nSuch log messages can be found with this grep statement:  `grep -Iir \"log\\.\" $(find . -name '*.go') | grep -i 'podIP'`\r\n\r\nAnother way to uniquely point to a Pod, and not use the IP address would be to use the Pod's UID (`Pod.ObjectMeta.UID`)\r\n\r\nI propose we change the IP in the UID of the pod (and change the verbiage of these messages accordingly).",
